title: Add self-boot Hybrid Receiver and receiver artifact boundary

before.state: OHF had Native blind bundles, Glyph Calculus and MicroISA experiments, but no carrier-neutral self-boot receiver contract tying BOOT, local symbol semantics, deterministic receiver rules and accessible-memory navigation together.
before.evidence: Native isolation and low-level deterministic transport existed as separate experimental mechanisms.

after.state: Experimental origami.hybrid-receiver.r0 defines BOOT -> ROSETTA -> PROGRAM -> INDEX -> MEMORY -> VERIFICATION, deterministic fail-closed reference execution, Hybrid public-bundle isolation and an Origami-owned receiver artifact registry.

invariants: Carrier-local symbols have no assumed global semantic meaning
Unknown symbols or transitions fail closed
Hybrid model-facing active context is bounded independently from total memory
Tlaloc may propose receiver candidates but Origami validates and stores promoted receiver artifacts
Current receiver remains REFERENCE_CANDIDATE until model-facing Hybrid evidence exists

impact.runtime_semantics: experimental receiver reference layer added; existing Origami core semantics are not redefined
impact.ohf: Glyph Calculus and SAFE_MICRO_ISA are positioned as possible low-level Hybrid execution substrates, not universal symbol semantics
impact.tlaloc: new experimental receiver-distillation contract consumed on its own feature branch
impact.tonal: composition proposal exists but lock pins remain unchanged until component promotion

notes: The Master Prompt is now a universal bootstrap reference candidate. Carrier-specific decoding semantics belong inside BOOT/ROSETTA/PROGRAM.
